edits.new: If a child requirement fails or an admitted case remains covered, test either a revision or an independent case. A revision must satisfy the whole child and preserve established exclusions while testing the remaining covering alternatives and permitted connections. An independent case requires its own complete admission and exclusion tests. Do not presume either approach can produce a valid counterexample; identify any child requirement or necessary implication preventing it.
edits.old: If a child requirement fails, test a correction satisfying it while preserving exclusion. If an admitted case remains covered by a parent alternative or permitted connection, attempt a variation preserving the whole child and established exclusions from other parent alternatives and permitted connections, and test whether it also escapes the covering alternative or connection. Do not presume such a variation exists; identify any child requirement or necessary implication preventing it.
